notes.title: NTRaholic Remix Update #2
notes.notes:
[h2]So what is going on?![/h2][p]
Listen guys, we were excited... ready to fucking go! But sometimes, things just don't work out the way you planned. Our lead programmer, handling most of the Remix project's coding, had to take his leave from Critical Bliss. It was nothing personal. He was simply offered a deal he couldn't refuse from the SFW side of the programming world. Despite our initial frustration, knowing that this would cause issues yet again, we still fully supported his choice and wished him well.

Sometimes, that's just how things go.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/21d1ad5ee9988dca7fbd1a6f0e97822d7ff4c7ff.png"][/img]As many people know, game dev can be hard sometimes. We are not immune to unforeseen setbacks and whatever crazy shit that can happen while an ambitious project is being created. While plenty of people see the potential of what we are doing with Remix, we are [b]fully aware that there is a minority of people who aren't interested in the Remix project and just want the original NTRaholic to finally be released on Steam.[/b]

[/p][h3]Something had to be done to address this, so we chatted with Tira and made a decision.[/h3][p]
[b][i]CB and Big Ass Studio (Tira) decided last year before the holidays that it would be best to sell the two products separately. [/i][/b]We both agreed this would be the best choice for the health of both games, but we didn't want to announce anything until things were more official with Steam and they approved of what we were doing. Sorry for taking so long to make this announcement, but we decided to make a statement when we were sure it was possible with Steam's approval.

[/p][h3]Does this mean Tira will be on his own when it comes to NTRaholic then?[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/3a846f74f1a42f9c858fb2bd97008047806312b4.png"][/img]Nope! As many of you know, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/MangoParty"]Tira is releasing "The Censor" with MangoParty, a fellow publisher we respect and are allied with[/url]. MangoParty has done a fantastic job getting "The Censor" ready for a Steam release, and we are happy to see them handling the release for NTRAholic as well.

With this, you will no longer have to wait for Remix for NTRAHOLIC to release--and for the few of you  [b]who don't want to support this project, that option will be available now. [/b]. Our success with Remix will now be solely on merit alone and will be up to us to impress you guys with our work and effort. When the steam page for NTRaholic is live on MangoParty's systems, we will let you guys know as soon as it's live! And we wish Tira and MP the best of luck!

[b]For those who are still interested in supporting both projects[/b], we are currently in talks for a potential Cross-Publisher bundle that will give you a certain percentage off for those who buy one or the other. If we get this sorted out will make sure this bundle is permanent, so the % off deal will always be provided regardless of what you buy.

Honestly, we are sorry that things took this long. A simple publishing deal spiraled into an ambitious project that both CB and Tira became passionate about. And if we knew things would drag out this long, we would for sure have done things differently! We hope this will remedy some issues.

[/p][h3]Alright... sure. But What about Remix? What happened with the Demo, and is development still ongoing?[/h3][p]
Alright, let's get to it! We have a few things to show and talk about!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/8964f97f853588902a3def87eb9f6f07c67498b8.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Programming[/h3][p]
As we mentioned above, losing our lead programmer was a bit of a blow that we had to remedy. To speed up future projects, we code in a way that allows for some of the systems we build to be reused, but this requires more advanced coding methods that "looking at a tutorial on YouTube" isn't really going to solve.

While we were able to find a replacement lead, we decided to hire more programmers and put them in charge of specific tasks for the overall project. While we are always aiming for high-quality projects, we are still learning the best way to handle things.

[/p][h3]A sample of what in the Demo[/h3][p]
Last time we talked about the game [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2173930/NTRaholic_Remix/"], we tried our best to explain to all of you how much effort went into it [/url][/b]. Considering that we didn't have our ideal demo prepared, we decided that it would be best for us to simply explain what will be in it once it's ready!

[/p][h3]Story[/h3][p]
The Remix Demo [i][b]will have all of Stage 0 section of game! [/b][/i]For those who played the original NTRAHOLIC, Stage 0 will end in a familiar part of the original game where Ryunosuke fucks Chiho for the first time. We consider this portion of the game to be the "introduction" before getting into the meat of the game. Later options truly open up and the player will have more freedom of what to do to some extent.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/528d21a59cff9a1a91858ffa5725960d67ca5715.png"][/img]As we explained before, we are [b][i]relatively[/i][/b] sticking close to the plot beats of the original. Ryunosuke becomes the couple's new landlord. Ryunosuke will use the powers he gained from Lilith to have Chiho believe that she has a genuine bond with him. It will be up to you if you get all the prerequisites, sort of, to choose when to strike.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/eec3fa5e888904bb6a4ad758551ab11fd023bf99.png"][/img]We have focused most of our focus on fleshing out the original cast, giving them more character and personal motivations. You will get a good sample of this from the demo and it will only expand from there in the actual game... 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/ee15510f54395d79068774e6dc29a1f162b824df.png"][/img]Remix is divided into 0 1 2 3 4 5 Stages! With stage 5 specifically being the post game after the Ryokan section of the title. We will discuss these stages more after we are finally happy with the demo we want to release to you guys. [b][i]We are especially excited for all of you to experience the Ryokan section of the game![/i][/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/9de987c5bc8ecaeec519b622ad04f228ed801b56.png"][/img][/p][h3]Mini Games[/h3][p]
Before we tell you some details on the mini-games you will be playing in the demo, please give us a bit to talk about our mini-game philosophy in Remix. While we understand that at the end of the day, these kinds of games are generally what people in the West would [b]call a "Cozy Game", we still feel obligated to create fun systems that require at least some degree of skill and a tad bit of brain power to engage. We have tried our best to stick to 4 rules to do this.[/b]

[b]1. Low point of entry with a moderate skill ceiling[/b]

At the end of the day, the aim of this simulation is for the game to still be rather relaxing to play. With this, we stuck with an important rule: All mini games must only require your mouse to play with [b][i], the only buttons being left click and right click[/i][/b]. 

[b]2. Reward players who play well with some kind of H content.[/b]

A lot of the time, there is not much reward in these kinds of games when it comes to them outside the mini-games that the player engages with the main wife. We have tried our best to ensure that every mini-game Ryunosuke plays has some kind of H rewords or that the mini-game itself is sexual in some manner.

[b]3. Make sure that all mini games scale with the experience.[/b]

With so much effort being put into these mini games, we wanted to make sure there are systems in place where players will have options to play harder versions of some mini-games. These harder versions will come with more H rewards of some kind or with a special currency in the game called "Succubus Coins" that players will be able to attain.

While there are general endings to the game that can be attained. Some endings will require engaging with more challenging content in order for you to unlock which will encourage repeated playthroughs.

[b]4. Have enough content and variation to entice players to return.[/b]

This one is the most important. It's part of why we put so much effort into content and design in the first place.  If we are going to have players replay certain elements of the game in order to get resources or increase Chiho's corruption we want the players to have enjoy themselves and have enough variety to not get bored.

[/p][h2]Main mini games that will be viable in the demo will be:[/h2][p]
[/p][h3]Chore Game V1 (Scrubbing Floor) and V2 (Washing Dishes/Cooking)
[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/e1f0b88e6546de7d10a6133391f127e0d4d59fb8.gif"][/img]One of the most familiar systems is this kind of game, where you call upon the wife to come over and clean your apartment. We have greatly expanded what is usually expected with about 50+ animations for just one pose alone. As Chiho's Corruption increases and you progress through her stages, more options will become viable. The wilder foreplay becomes available, the deeper you explore the system, as well as hidden animation and reactions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/6ca6a64fa6b0d234579607ee93d6701ff3723dcc.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Private Massage
[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/7b964b7eac3b7e604551854adbd3d9e0f9156052.png"][/img]This mini-game clearly took inspiration from NTR Legend, where the protagonist also worked as a masseuse. We really liked the idea and thought of a way to add our own spin. After some back-and-forth, we ended up landing on an idea!

[/p][previewyoutube="qoWWCtACy-w;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
For those who have ever played Final Fantasy X-2, you will instantly understand what we are trying to accomplish. However, we wanted to expand on this system further to make it even more interactive.

He is our design doc for the mini game!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/6c75b650341133bc5d7826730a2cfc266f942b1f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/cd8325b01359ea4859d9ab78fcb205ace838bfd5.png"][/img]There will be 3 variations of girls! Each variation have 4 poses that will be fully animated!

[/p][h3]Hi Low Drinking Game[/h3][p]
This is meant to replace the drinking Janken game in NTRaholic. We wanted to make a drinking game that could also be played with multiple characters, as we wanted some special events to happen based on certain situations.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/80c5e0eb606f5801ed5b596c9de35315b6b47e40.png"][/img]Oh boy, let us admit something to all of you. This took us a while to get right. One of the primary things we wanted to avoid is having any mini games that you can play be 100% based on chance. We don't find things like this fun, nor do we think most gamers do either, especially when it's a system that is meant to be revisited.

After multiple iterations we finally landed on the system we have now. We had to create an original card game that can be played with real people! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/25c83c96cb8174c9ca9eaa5dd505b5af5ea51bb0.gif"][/img]Even with the card game's mechanics being figured out we still felt like we needed something else. So we took some inspiration yet again from AAA and integrated it into the mini game in Remix.

[/p][previewyoutube="vdl-MazQiBU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
To get this game right we deeply underestimated the task. Making a good card game was a surprisingly difficult task and we are happy to finally be past it.

[/p][h3]Animation and Art
[/h3][p]There is so much animation that it's simply better for all of you to witness it yourselves when the game releases. We can, however, assure you that whatever you think it is, it's more than likely more than that.

Despite this, we still use stills to progress elements of the story, much like Takeda Hiromitsu does in 爆乳パーティーNTR進捗 (Big Breast NTR Party). This aspect of the game is what we are most proud of, as we had to figure out studio-level animation on the fly. While we are sure we will do better in future titles, we are incredibly proud of what we are doing. 

We can't wait for all of you to play and experience this!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/328f8637a0e1368953786f2a4522cfd5c7e9ae27.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/1a2bdfa07c16cdc99fe6f312686f0102c9886c9d.gif"][/img]Anyway this update is already way too long. And we still haven't covered even half of the content of the overall game experience. There will plenty to look forward to. Too much for us to even explain properly. You are just gonna have to play it!

[/p][h2]Here is some random stuff![/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/0e0f49e2b70ab61ebc88875c2e627b2f8252ebcf.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/79025b332af3bcb3bfba4a731a952b4ab2d6283a.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/f1ef6ec32c669f84cefa9bb846e1b2e93bf20f8d.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: NTRaholic Remix Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/840cf3676f61905e4cedb20754e12e940dce7562.png[/img]

Hello again, everyone! Yes, yes... we know. It's been a while.

Everyone here at Critical Bliss has been busy for several months, slaving away quietly. We are finally ready to reveal more about what is happening as we enter our marketing cycles.

Since Critical Bliss started working on making changes to make the original Ntraholic a better product, Tiramisu has been fascinated by our overall vision and approach that we take to making adult games. He has been impressed by our commitment to innovation and high-quality standards, watching over time just how much we care about delivering products with high production values. As time passed, we were given more freedom to do as we please, while still respecting the Isometric Eroge genre. What was originally meant to be a simple engine port with better quality-of-life features has since become the fantastic product it is now. With continued support from Ntraholic's original creator, Tiramisu, we've made the game into [b]one of Critical Bliss purely in-house production release: NTRaholic Remix![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/669fb69cb4ea49e80c3f062d0c392b089167aed3.gif[/img]

We want to also announce that as of today, it will be our responsibility to deliver information regarding NTRaholic Remix. With us entering our marketing cycle for the game, everyone will now be getting far more information leading up to its release. 

[b]A developer page will also be made soon on Ci-En to commemorate us entering our marketing cycle. [/b] This will only be used as an update blog you can follow, as we do not need crowdfunding, but this space will also exist for those who prefer that environment to receive news on H-games.

We know many of you have questions and concerns about the game's future. Seeing all the buzz — and more importantly, questions — on our community page, we must answer some of the most pressing and recurring ones.

[h3]What is NTRaholic Remix?[/h3]

NTRaholic Remix is a reimagining of the original Ntraholic. It will feature a reworked, expanded story and characterization, with vastly improved animation and production quality. The core of the experience introduced with NTR Legend / Summer Memories will mostly remain unchanged and be very familiar to those who already enjoy isometric H-Games.

To best illustrate our point and intentions, [b]think of what Ntraholic is to NTRaholic Remix in the same fashion as what the original Resident Evil 4 is to the Resident Evil 4 remake.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/b18385ea842c7c557c2e84e45d3a899810d6f670.png[/img]

[h3]Why has the game's development taken so long?[/h3]

Critical Bliss has obligations to all of our partners, and the other developers we've been working with have been at the forefront of our minds. After the release of FlipWitch, we refocused our R&D efforts on NTRaholic Remix. We took a step back and [b]realized that our approach to the isometric was wrong and we needed to rethink things.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/138c83680341ab2d4047a9fd7725dca79794109c.png[/img]

While trying to figure this out, [b]Tiramisu has gave us his full blessings.[/b] He saw the potential for this to be an interesting alternative to the original game and gave us more time to make it as unique as possible. [b]We have been transparent, clearly showing Tira our development every step of the way. [/b]

[b]We give updates daily with substantial content done at incredible speeds.[/b] Most importantly, he was amazed at how well-coordinated and happy our team was to work on the Remix project. That has been the most essential element, the sheer passion of everyone involved.

[h3] Will you have a sample for us to play soon?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/daaf1083d5473909cd1b630665e86b02aa0061c3.png[/img]

We initially planned to release the demo for the upcoming Steam Next Fest, but upon further consideration, decided that the demo needed more polish to make a superb first impression. If things go well, [b]we plan to release the demo sometime this month.[/b] We focused a lot of our asset efforts onto the game's larger aspects, so the title's start needs some more work.

As for what's in the demo...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/ee14332cbdd48d4bb5f9275e4f0a61ba7bc77d8b.png[/img]

The game is divided into 6 Stages, with the 6th stage more than likely being a free update in the future. What will be in the demo is Stage 0, which will lead up to the first time that Ryunosuke fucks Chiho. These sequences of events will play out similarly to the original, but there are substantial differences that will set forth expectations for the rest of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/7b964b7eac3b7e604551854adbd3d9e0f9156052.png[/img]

[h3]What are you guys currently doing now?[/h3]

NTRaholic Remix is currently in its "polishing phase". This means that all of the main assets of the game are entering post-production. We want to tighten up the story beats, improving the quality of several animations, committing to extensive bug-fixing, and looking over an assortment of mini-games to make sure the experience is a fun one. With that in mind, we aim to release NTRaholic Remix in late Q4 2024 at the earliest or early Q1 2025 at the latest. 

[h3]So... how much content is actually in the game?[/h3]

We will keep this brief, as I think it best to show you evidence of our progress visually.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/c5e5da03f729e7220af663ff35621710798b7cee.png[/img]

There are over 100+ isometric animations, with alternate movement variations and expression changes! This does not factor in idle or slice-of-life animations; that's 100+ animations of nothing but pure sex, featuring some of the highest quality pixel art ever seen in H-games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/2173276c3ed39a61e5a2d8dc6e80ab71a7af7305.gif[/img]

And that's just the isometric poses... we have even more animations spread throughout the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/f1e83c7dca8f082066f3c65583c20a0ee912c195.gif[/img]

For example, the chore game has even more pixel-art-styled animations, and there are two different versions of it. One is for scrubbing the floor and one is for washing dishes, just like NTR Legend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/96aafffd867d404c405d086b8bbbc999799fad07.png[/img]

While our more silent approach can be frustrating for many who are used to avenues like Patreon and other subscription-based services that provide updates every two weeks... don't mistake our silence for not doing any work. We are focused on the task at hand and choose when is the best time to start marketing the material.

However, we do think we can be more generous with how we distribute information. We will find a compromise when a title is in deep production — even if they are only some brief glimpse at things we're doing. 

The content continues beyond there, though! We have more than just pixel art and still CGs...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/609dc94713ef3e900faf56da2855b13a21c075ba.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/935309fbef87e8031dca3148974329f326e4d9d6.gif[/img]

With the dawn of AI, it's important to do something AI couldn't do easily: create amazing hand-drawn animations, frame-by-frame. We've stepped away from Live2D to deliver something similar to studio animation quality. [b]Remix 1.0 will have 30+ studio anime tier animations of pure sexual action.[/b]

We took great inspiration from scene execution established by Takeda Hiromitsu in 爆乳パーティーNTR進捗 (Big Breast NTR Party) with his smart use of still images transitioning into animation. Remix is the first game we've created from scratch, and we want to do our best to deliver a title of remarkable quality.

We have other types of handmade animation sprinkled throughout the whole experience, as well... it's really hard to even quantify the amount. We are just working and making things look good as we go.

You'll just see for yourself when the game is done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/c3a2478ccac82a5b601332e10cf4f0536592d4e0.gif[/img]

As for why we are putting in so much effort: This is to reward our fans who have patiently supported us and helped us grow into one of the leading adult publishers in the industry over the years. We want to show that all the revenue we earn is returned to you by providing you all with a great experience.

Buy our games, and we can make even better games in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/315967f64c1ccfb4ad7bbdb127a4e15d3ba49cab.gif[/img]

[h3]What languages will NTRAHOLIC Remix be released in? [/h3]

NTRAHOLIC Remix will be released in English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Thai, Spanish (Spain and LATAM), Brazilian Portuguese, and Chinese (Traditional and Simplified). 

The game will include partial Japanese voice-acting.

[h3]When will you begin to make store page changes?[/h3]

To reflect the current status of NTRAHOLIC Remix as a game, we also plan to gradually change the Steam store page assets so that they better demonstrate the game's contemporary state and give you a much more thorough look into its future.

[h3] In Conclusion[/h3]

After making the announcement of us improving this game, [b]our wishlists have sky rocketed and we are currently sitting at 170K wishlists[/b] for this title, despite us only showing teasers as we were developing it. This is simply a testament to why it's so important for us to ensure that this project is as great as it needs to be.

Thank you all for your time! The next few months are going to get really exciting!!! It's finally time to start showing off our work! [b]We have hope that NTRaholic Remix will be among the best Netori games ever made.[/b]

And yes... of course its going to have excellent music.

[previewyoutube=O8w_A62GgRA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Also, here... have a dog.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/f0db79ab2a8b4bfffe11ea6d0c0325841d156ca8.png[/img]

notes.title: Progress report, Steam achievement suggestions and Steam release delay
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/cfe8558b989762b4852a2234dd12a9bdbcaea861.png[/img]

[h1]Steam Release Delay:[/h1]
We are sorry to announce that the Steam release is now scheduled to roughly mid-May. 

There are some reasons accounted for the delay: 

-. We have to modify the game a bit and make it a steam standard game. This will take some more time.
For example, we might have to modify the ending comic to get rid of the family photo in the ending.  
-. We need some time to set up some interesting "achievements" in steam. If you have any interesting ideas for the achievement, please let us know! 
-. We need to get prepare for some more documents before the steam release so that we won't have taxation, legal issues. 
-. We want to release the game to steam with the full version. (Including the after stories.) 

[h1]Progress Report:[/h1]

 -. 90% of the in-game content is done. 
 -. Ending Comics are done. (There will be multiple endings. Steam version and DLsite version might be different in terms of the ending comic.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/24c31284eaa5eed7dc80c536fe968c08451350ce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/537c4ac3c642e8e2ee71e92e355d77fb9ce41da2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452816/64306ce189f6c7b7e6da8b474631ec0cb49b3657.png[/img]

-. We are currently working on some more pixel art animations to be added in the after-stories. (After stories: 30% done).

 [h1]Steam Achievement suggestions:[/h1]

We are currently preparing some fun Steam in-game achievements for our players! If you have any interesting ideas, please tell us in the comment sections. It will be better in the form of:
[b][Achievement name]:[Achievement description] + [How to unlock this achievement]. 
[/b]For example:
"Waifu from the Ring": "Well, then. Shall we? My fair cuckold, eternal" + "Unlock: Touch the Doll for the first time"

[b]We will select a number of most interesting replies and offer the commenter with free steam keys! 
[/b]
